Job description

 

About the opportunity:

We are seeking a Java Developer who is passionate about developing modern applications and contributing to projects centered on innovation, technology advancement, and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will join an international environment where collaboration spans multiple teams and areas of expertise. You will work on enterprise-grade applications, enhance existing solutions, and support initiatives focused on technology modernization and system optimization.

The ideal candidate is proactive, enjoys problem-solving, and can work independently while also thriving as part of a collaborative team.

 

What you will be doing:

 

• Design and development of core application modules

• Participation in meetings with the customer

• Task decomposition and estimation

• Bug fixing, test writing

 

What we are looking for (please do not apply if you do not meet the basic requirements below):

 

• Java development experience 2+ years

• Basic knowledge of Android development[SP1] 

• Strong Java Core knowledge

• Good understanding of design patterns

• Experience using Maven, Gradle

• Experience using Git

• Basic SQL knowledge and experience with MySQL/Oracle/SQLite/PostgresSQL databases[SP2] 

• English - advanced both verbally and in writing

• Proactive, problem-solving attitude

• Communication and presentation skills

 

Nice to have (desirable):

• Experience in Agile/SCRUM

• Experience with Web technologies (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap,etc)

• Strong SQL knowledge (MySQL / Oracle)

• Experience working with Spring, SpringBoot framework, Hibernate, REST API

• Experience working with EVM flow, EFT-POS terminals, SoftPos or other payment systems is a plus
